title: Digital presenter
heading: Your face. Your next story.
description: Prepare a portrait video, approve the voice, make lip-synced clips and arrange them in IP Video.
localOnly: Projects and history stay in this browser
projectNamePlaceholder: For example: Product introduction · First take
deleteProjectHint: Removes this project's local media and clip records. Other pages' exports and submitted remote jobs are unaffected. Download anything you want to keep first.
authorization: I have permission to use these faces, voices and videos, and agree to upload the selected media for synthesis
portraitAuthDockHint: Confirm you have legal rights to the face and voice in your base video, then check Portrait rights on the right before uploading or submitting lip-sync.
portraitAuthDockOk: Portrait and voice rights confirmed. You can upload a base video and run lip-sync.
portraitAuthAwaitingSource: Upload a base video on the left before confirming portrait rights.
scriptMetaAwaitingSource: Upload a base video to see duration and credit estimates
privacy: Selected video and audio are uploaded only when you request synthesis. A local copy of the original is retained for reuse.
uploadYourself: Start with a video of yourself
shootingHint: One person, front-facing, clear face, even light—minimal occlusion and head turns.
sourceHint: Reuse one presenter video with different scripts. Set the final aspect ratio and placement in IP Video.
resolutionError: Each video edge must be between 640 and 2048 pixels. Resize the video first.
advancedDialogDesc: Public URLs, face reference, and extension
publicUrlHintShort: Direct link, no sign-in required; overrides local upload when set.
referenceHintShort: Pick the target face in multi-person footage; JPG/PNG/WebP/BMP, up to 10 MB.
extensionAlgoNote: When the source is shorter than the speech, forward and reverse playback alternate to match audio length.
publicVideoUrl: Or enter a public video URL
publicUrlHint: When entered, this URL takes priority. It must be downloadable without signing in. Also use this when the upload policy requires a public URL.
referenceHint: Required for multi-person footage. JPG / PNG / WebP / BMP, up to 10 MB, aspect ratio at most 2, longest edge at most 4096 px.
referenceError: The reference image must have a longest edge of at most 4096 px and an aspect ratio of at most 2.
publicReferenceUrl: Or enter a public face-reference URL
extendVideo: Allow alternating forward / reverse playback to extend the source
extensionHint: Use only if the source is shorter than the speech. Reversed motion may look unnatural; a longer source is preferable.
extensionRequired: The source video is shorter than the audio. Choose a longer video, or explicitly allow forward / reverse extension in advanced settings to avoid truncated speech.
sourceRequired: Upload a presenter video or enter a downloadable public video URL.
scriptHint: Preview audio on this page, then generate lip-sync. Re-dub after script edits; earlier versions are kept.
scriptPlaceholder: Write what this clip should say. A script is optional for uploaded audio; add text or import SRT later for subtitles.
importPanelPreviewEmpty: No audio yet. Pick a source under Sources first.
importPanelPreviewOnDock: Audio is ready—preview below, then use Generate scene at the bottom to create lip-sync.
importUploadDesc: Upload mp3, wav, or other local files
dubRequiredHint: Add dubbing, preview it here, then generate lip-sync
publicAudioUrl: Or enter a public audio URL
scriptDubDockDeleteBlocked: Cannot remove dub while a scene is bound or a task is in progress.
audioStale: This audio does not match the current script. Generate matching audio or restore the corresponding script before lip-syncing.
monitorDockDubEmpty: No audio yet. Generate or import on the right.
otherTaskActive: This account already has a lip-sync job in progress. Wait for it to finish before submitting the next clip.
retryCountdown: The platform queue is full. Wait {{seconds}} seconds as requested by the server before submitting again. No automatic retry will occur.
billingHint: Voice and lip-sync are billed separately under backend rules. Lip-sync is settled on success by actual output duration. Backend amounts are authoritative. Layout and subtitle changes do not regenerate lip-sync.
remoteWaiting: Processing remotely. You can leave this page and resume status checks later. Stages are real; no completion percentage is invented.
resultEmpty: After you preview audio on the right and generate lip-sync, the result plays here.
monitorResultDeleteBlocked: Cannot remove the result while a lip-sync task is in progress.
monitorSourceDeleteBlocked: Cannot remove the base video while a lip-sync task is in progress.
retention: Site videos are normally retained for about 7 days. A fallback temporary URL may last only 24 hours. Download promptly.
expired: The video URL no longer exists or has passed its retention period. Review the job before deciding whether to regenerate.
downloadFailed: Could not download the result. Check your connection or try again later.
audioLoadFailed: Could not load the saved audio. Check your connection or select another take.
uncertainHint: The previous response was not confirmed; the job may already exist. Confirm with its original submission key rather than creating another job.
regenerateHint: Generating again creates a new submission and may incur a new charge. Check the error, source and audio first.
timelineRailSubtitle: Generate a lip-sync clip per paragraph; when one or more are ready, arrange and export them in IP Video.
composeDisabledHint: Finish at least one lip-sync clip before opening IP Video to arrange and export.
segmentHint: Generate audio and lip-sync independently for each clip, then arrange completed clips in IP Video. Each input must be 2–120 seconds.
storageBoundary: Drafts, sources and history stay in this account's local browser, not a permanent cloud library. Temporary uploads expire in about 48 hours; local copies are uploaded again when the cached reference expires. The local presenter library is limited to 800 MB; download and clean up when full. Stable production storage still needs confirmation before launch.
demoBoundary: This is a demo environment. Real voice and lip-sync submissions are disabled; no fake videos or charges are produced.
historyHint: Reads this account's actual completed jobs in this browser without generating again.
realVideoScriptOnly: Choose a completed real video script. Live scripts and demo outputs cannot be imported here.
emptyImport: This job contains no usable script or audio.
